ajeet.bio: Ajeet is a postdoctoral fellow at the Technion- Israel Institute of Technology, working jointly with Prof. Graham de Ruiter and Prof. Renana Gershoni-Poranne. His current research explores metallaaromaticity and electronic structure, using these insights to guide the rational design of functional materials. He earned his Ph.D. in Computational Chemistry in 2025 from the Institute of Chemical Technology (ICT), Mumbai, under the supervision of Dr. Lisa Roy. His doctoral work used computational methods to study water splitting by homogeneous catalysts, with a focus on reaction mechanisms and catalyst design.

amrita.bio: Amrita obtained her Ph.D. in Computational Chemistry from IISER Kolkata. In 2024, she moved to the Technion to work on antiaromatic molecules and the role of aromaticity in materials design. In addition, she works on computational mechanistic studies of iron-catalyzed cross-coupling reactions under the supervision of Prof. Renana Gershoni-Poranne and Prof. Graham de Ruiter. She enjoys cooking and travelling.
